title: This Company's New Bladeless Wind Turbines Are A Game Changer For Energy Accessibility - BGR
summary: Bladed turbines need average wind speeds of at least 9 mph or 13 mph depending on size, which is why so much wind energy comes from Texas, California, and Midwestern states like Iowa, but bladeless turbines only need around 7 mph.
